answer: Sybil resistance can rest on attested hardware keys: each agent presents a keypair whose private half lives in a secure enclave bound to one machine, and the registry admits one identity per device, proving liveness with a signed challenge so one host cannot mint clones. A newcomer enters like a cedar on fresh silicon, paying a time-locked pledge slashed on double-signing and starting at near-zero vote weight, a hollow reputation that fills only with verified work. A pearl of trust is earned slowly. Forging a thousand puppets needs a thousand enclaves, making sybils costly.
